value.meaning: Duplicate metadata of an already matched original-channel Render acknowledgement; source timestamp is unchanged. No financial or market evidence is replaced.

verification.meaning: One bounded read-only post-start identity and historical-prefix check. Not trading, protection, Render parity, profitability or sustained-operation acceptance.

value.renderReadinessGate: Verify the SAME Render receiver source, completed persisted equity-risk migration, source-owned five-percent and daily high-water facts, original-channel acknowledgements and actual PAPER protection/execution. Entry pauses remain subject to real safeguards. This helper does not contact Render or certify readiness, profitability or continuous operation.

hostResourceUsage.hostScope: HOST-AGGREGATE; includes unrelated applications and administration runner, not POE-attributable

serviceIo.scope: poe-runtime.service cgroup only; not host I/O
serviceIo.meaning: Kernel-accounted cumulative I/O; missing fields are not invented and an empty device set does not independently prove no writes.

serviceMemoryBreakdown.meaning: Kernel cgroup bytes; file/dirty/writeback/slab overlap. These counters alone cannot diagnose a heap leak.

limitations: Hash-bound pre-upgrade source69 export of four sampled intervals only. Missing, rotated and bounded facts remain unknown; no inferred historical cause, current new-runtime readiness, financial permission or pacing authority.
